first_party_results.reason: Timestamps enforce deposit, scheduled-start, result-submission, dispute, finalization, and refund deadlines. They do not control randomness or select the winner.
The deposit entry point intentionally performs explicit terms, signature, ownership, discipline, replay, and state validation before NFT custody.
The first-party pragma is pinned to 0.8.30. Slither reports mixed directives inherited from pinned OpenZeppelin dependencies.
